sections.title: How does an enterprise think, learn, decide, predict, and act intelligently?
Phase Objective
paragraphs: The goal of Phase 32 is to define the intelligence architecture that enables KoreVity-powered enterprises to understand their environment, generate knowledge, make intelligent decisions, coordinate AI systems, and continuously improve through learning.
